# refd — open-source AI search monitoring

> Know when AI answers mention your brand, and who they mention instead.

refd (refd.ai) is an open-source platform for monitoring brand visibility in AI
search. It tracks how often a brand is mentioned and cited in AI-generated
answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI
Overviews, and how that compares to the competitors you choose to track. It is
available as a hosted app at refd.ai or can be self-hosted on your own
infrastructure. Bright Data is the only data provider.

## Who it is for

Marketing, SEO, and brand teams who need to understand how their brand shows up
when buyers ask questions to AI assistants — and who is mentioned instead when it
does not. If your customers increasingly start research inside an AI chat rather
than a search box, refd is the instrument for measuring your presence there.

## Answer surfaces

refd monitors five AI answer surfaces:

- ChatGPT
- Perplexity
- Gemini
- Google AI Mode
- Google AI Overviews

Every active prompt is checked across every surface on each run.

## What refd measures

For each answer, refd records four independent signals:

- **Mentions** — whether your brand (or a tracked competitor) is named in the
  answer text.
- **Citations** — whether your domain (or a competitor's) appears among the
  answer's source links. "Mentioned" and "cited" are independent: an answer can
  name a brand without citing it, and cite a domain without naming it.
- **First-mention position** — the order in which tracked entities are first
  mentioned in the answer, so you can see who leads the response.
- **Share of voice** — your presence relative to the competitors you track,
  across the prompt set.

Every raw answer is stored, so any score can be opened and traced back to the
exact answer it came from.

## How monitoring works

Each workspace tracks a single brand along with a set of competitors and a set of
prompts — the buyer questions you care about. On a daily schedule, refd runs
every active prompt across every surface, scores the answers, and updates the
dashboard.

Because AI answers are non-deterministic — the same question can produce
different answers minute to minute — refd takes repeat samples of each prompt and
encourages comparing trends across runs rather than reading any single answer as
ground truth.

A missing Google AI Overview is a valid result, not an error: AI Overviews appear
on only a fraction of queries, so their absence is itself a data point.

## Competitors and citation gaps

You choose which competitors to track. refd then compares your brand to them
across mentions, citations, first-mention position, and share of voice. It also
surfaces citation gaps: the domains cited on prompts where your brand is absent,
so you can see which sources may be shaping AI answers in your category.

## Hosted or self-hosted

- **Hosted** — sign up at refd.ai and start tracking a brand. The first workspace
  is created for you.
- **Self-hosted** — deploy the complete stack on your own Cloudflare and Bright
  Data accounts. Nothing phones home, and you keep all of your data.

## Architecture

refd is a single Cloudflare Worker that does everything: the Hono API, a
scheduled cron trigger, a queue consumer, and the React dashboard served as
static assets. It uses Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) for structured data, R2 for the raw
answer payloads, and Queues for orchestration. The dashboard is a React single
page app with dithered, monochrome charts. The entire codebase is open source.

## Privacy

Bright Data is the only external data provider, used solely to run prompts
against the answer surfaces. Data is isolated per workspace. When self-hosted,
nothing is sent back to refd.

## Getting started

- Create an account: https://refd.ai/auth/create-account
- Sign in: https://refd.ai/auth/sign-in
- Source code: https://github.com/emaitchess/refd
